'''Sea horrors''' are monsters found in [[The Shadow Reef]].

These monsters attack with very strong melee attacks, and they also possess a special attack where they scream at the player and cause very high soft typeless damage to players within seven spaces of their target. A [[Witchwood icon]] can be worn to reduce the damage this attack does.

Unlike other monsters in elite dungeons (with the exception of [[Kal'gerion demon (The Shadow Reef)|Kal'gerion demons]]), sea horrors do not pursue players outside their initial location. 

Three sea horrors on the second section of the Shadow Reef continually respawn. They are located behind the barrier where the miniboss [[Quetzathog]] spawns, allowing the player to kill sea horrors for a slayer task. Leaving the dungeon after unlocking the barrier where they are located may cause them to despawn. Players wishing to complete the slayer task here should fill inventory with combat supplies before opening the barrier. There is also a [[safe spot]] on the stairs leading to the area.
